derivation:
by
  apply AddSubmonoid.ext; intro x
  simpa only [AddSubmonoid.mem_bot, not_not] using (not_congr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero (a := x)))
explanation: Mathlib characterizes units in any group with zero as precisely the nonzero elements. Negating this characterization and applying extensionality gives the stated equality of additive submonoids.
